_about: Golden vectors for bounded x_term_getline_editor (W16), via harness 'B [preload_hex]/key_hex'. field_width=21, max_len=81. preload in JSON is plain ASCII (script hex-encodes it). Tab=09 rc=1, Shift-Tab CSI Z rc=2, ESC rc=3, Ctrl-C rc=4.

field_escape.desc: Partial line + bare ESC (no newline on exit)

field_long_entry.desc: Type 30 chars (> viewport 21) + Enter; full buffer kept

field_preload_append.desc: Preload 24 digits, append X at EOL + Enter

field_preload_home_insert.desc: Preload 30x a, Home, insert b at start

field_preload_left_insert.desc: Preload 21 chars (full viewport), Left, insert X before last char

field_preload_scroll_edit.desc: Preload 40 zeros, Home+Right+Right, insert dot at index 2

field_backspace_eol.desc: Preload hello, BS at EOL + Enter -> hell

field_overwrite_inplace.desc: W12: preload 21-char full field, Home, Insert(OVR), type ABC over first 3, Enter -> length unchanged
